# StudyBg

> StudyBg (https://studybg.ac) is an independent admissions support service for international students who want to study Medicine or Dentistry, taught in English, at Bulgaria's four medical universities: Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna and Pleven. It offers a free online eligibility check and a paid €180 "Admissions Gateway" (one-time fee). StudyBg is not a university or an official representative of one, and it does not guarantee admission, visas or professional registration. Applicants can always apply to each university directly.

Key facts:

- Free eligibility check: five questions, runs in the browser, no sign-up or payment. Compares the applicant's Biology and Chemistry grades, citizenship and school country with what the chosen university publishes, and links to the official requirements.
- €180 Admissions Gateway (one-time, taxes included, no subscription) includes: an application and qualification review; a 45-minute video consultation; a document and deadline plan (legalisation, sworn translation, submission); and a StudyBg account with secure document uploads and review notes.
- Not included in the €180: university tuition, application and entrance-exam fees; sworn translation, apostille, legalisation and notary fees; courier; visa and residence fees; travel, housing, insurance and living costs.
- Each university sets its own requirements and deadlines. Example: the Medical University of Plovdiv's published 2026/27 guide asks for an average of at least 62% in school Biology and Chemistry. Facts on the site are checked against each university's official page, with the review date shown.

- [How to study medicine in Bulgaria in English](https://studybg.ac/study-medicine-in-bulgaria/): entry requirements, documents, legalisation, translation, intakes, visas, costs and practising after graduation.
